records.title: Performance Characterization of Expert Router for Scalable LLM Inference
records.reason: The arXiv abstract introduces Expert Router, which sends prompts to specialized expert LLMs; it characterizes quantized and non-quantized Llama 3 setups under up to 1,000 concurrent users and reports throughput/latency behavior for scalable deployment.

records.title: Fitting Is Not Enough: Smoothness in Extremely Quantized LLMs
records.reason: The abstract identifies smoothness degradation beyond numerical error in extremely low-bit LLM quantization and proposes smoothness-preserving PTQ and QAT principles; it connects quantization to decoding-tree sparsity and generation quality.

records.title: LRQ-DiT: Log-Rotation Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Transformers for Image and Video Generation
records.reason: The primary abstract confines the method to quantizing Diffusion Transformers for text-to-image/text-to-video generation, describing log quantization and activation-outlier rotations. It establishes image/video generation as the application and no LLM inference or serving connection.

records.title: LO-BCQ: Block Clustered Quantization for 4-bit (W4A4) LLM Inference
records.reason: The arXiv primary record uses the title prefix “LO-BCQ” (the worklist says “BCQ”) under the same arXiv ID. Its abstract presents block-statistics clustering and per-cluster codebooks for weight-and-activation W4A4 PTQ, reporting under 1% inference-accuracy loss across LLMs.

records.title: SONIC: Segmented Optimized Nexus for Information Compression in Key-Value Caching
records.reason: The primary abstract targets the growing KV cache in multi-turn LLM deployment, compressing dialogue history into reusable Nexus tokens with dynamic budgets; it reports improved cache-compression benchmarks and faster inference than full-context generation.

records.title: CacheNotes: Task-Aware Key-Value Cache Compression for Reasoning-Intensive Knowledge Tasks
records.reason: The ACL Anthology publisher abstract introduces task-conditioned Compression-Planning-Tokens and a reusable compressed KV cache for LLM inference; it reports lower latency and improved QA over RAG at 20x compression.

records.title: HubRouter: A Pluggable Sub-Quadratic Routing Primitive for Hybrid Sequence Models
records.reason: The abstract replaces quadratic attention with learned-hub routing at O(nM), reports training-throughput and perplexity results on hybrid and Transformer architectures, and explicitly describes a negative retrofit case; this is a concrete attention-compute systems contribution.

records.title: ToolSpec: Accelerating Tool Calling via Schema-Aware and Retrieval-Augmented Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The primary abstract addresses tool-call latency in real-time LLM serving with schema-constrained, retrieval-augmented speculative decoding and reports up to 4.2x speedup.

records.title: KVSculpt: KV Cache Compression as Distillation
records.reason: The abstract optimizes a smaller set of unconstrained KV pairs to preserve layer attention behavior, with adaptive compression-budget allocation; the measured target is long-context LLM inference cache compression.

records.title: FOVEA: Focused On-Demand Visual Evidence Adaptation for Cache-Friendly Multimodal Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The abstract accelerates speculative decoding for vision-language models by reusing visual memory and selecting bounded task/state-specific evidence for the draft model, explicitly balancing visual grounding against context overhead.

records.title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
records.reason: The primary abstract restores quality after query-agnostic KV eviction using a compact learned restore cache under the same KV budget; it evaluates long-context LLM benchmarks and reports minimal one-time construction overhead.

records.title: Nemotron-Flash: Towards Latency-Optimal Hybrid Small Language Models
records.reason: The abstract optimizes real-device SLM latency through depth-width choices and operator search, then reports latency and throughput improvements against Qwen models; this directly targets deployment efficiency.

records.title: On The Application of Linear Attention in Multimodal Transformers
records.reason: The primary abstract identifies quadratic attention cost as a scalability barrier in vision-language backbones and evaluates linear attention in multimodal transformer architectures, reporting reduced sequence-length compute with competitive performance.

records.title: How Many Parameters Does Your Task Really Need? Task Specific Pruning with LLM-Sieve
records.reason: The abstract prunes task-irrelevant LLM weights via output-aligned low-rank projections and adaptive search, retaining task performance while removing 20–75% of weights; it explicitly targets resource-constrained deployment and integrates with quantization.

records.title: JuDi: Revisiting Judge Decoding from First Principles via Training-Free Distributional Divergence
records.reason: The abstract replaces costly/noisy judge supervision in speculative decoding with training-free draft-target KL-divergence verification, a direct LLM inference acceleration mechanism.

records.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
records.reason: The abstract targets computationally unsustainable LLM recommenders and uses adaptive layer exits/router for efficient full-corpus ranking; the contribution is inference-side adaptive compute for compact LLMs.

records.title: Nirvana: A Specialized Generalist Model With Task-Aware Memory Mechanism
records.reason: The abstract describes an LLM specialized-generalist model with task-aware memory and linear-time complexity. Its test-time task extraction and dynamic context consolidation provide a concrete model-memory and inference-cost connection.

records.title: Enhancing Linear Attention with Residual Learning
records.reason: The abstract adds a recurrent residual-correction state to linear attention and reports language-modeling results while retaining linear time and memory; it also cites optimized linear-attention kernels.

records.title: Caracal: Causal Architecture via Spectral Mixing
records.reason: The primary abstract replaces quadratic attention with causal FFT-based O(L log L) sequence mixing, targeting long-context LLM scalability and portable deployment without hardware-specific kernels.
